title: Peacock waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Tail feathers fan -->
  <g>
    <!-- Outer fan feathers -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='40' ry='30' fill='#1a6b3c'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='36' ry='26' fill='#228B4B'/>
    <!-- Feather eyes on tail -->
    <circle cx='24' cy='38' r='6' fill='#0a4a2a'/>
    <circle cx='24' cy='38' r='4' fill='#2ECC71'/>
    <circle cx='24' cy='38' r='2' fill='#F1C40F'/>
    <circle cx='24' cy='38' r='1' fill='#E74C3C'/>

    <circle cx='38' cy='28' r='6' fill='#0a4a2a'/>
    <circle cx='38' cy='28' r='4' fill='#2ECC71'/>
    <circle cx='38' cy='28' r='2' fill='#F1C40F'/>
    <circle cx='38' cy='28' r='1' fill='#E74C3C'/>

    <circle cx='62' cy='28' r='6' fill='#0a4a2a'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='28' r='4' fill='#2ECC71'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='28' r='2' fill='#F1C40F'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='28' r='1' fill='#E74C3C'/>

    <circle cx='76' cy='38' r='6' fill='#0a4a2a'/>
    <circle cx='76' cy='38' r='4' fill='#2ECC71'/>
    <circle cx='76' cy='38' r='2' fill='#F1C40F'/>
    <circle cx='76' cy='38' r='1' fill='#E74C3C'/>

    <circle cx='30' cy='50' r='5' fill='#0a4a2a'/>
    <circle cx='30' cy='50' r='3.5' fill='#2ECC71'/>
    <circle cx='30' cy='50' r='1.5' fill='#F1C40F'/>

    <circle cx='70' cy='50' r='5' fill='#0a4a2a'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='50' r='3.5' fill='#2ECC71'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='50' r='1.5' fill='#F1C40F'/>

    <circle cx='46' cy='38' r='5' fill='#0a4a2a'/>
    <circle cx='46' cy='38' r='3.5' fill='#2ECC71'/>
    <circle cx='46' cy='38' r='1.5' fill='#F1C40F'/>

    <circle cx='54' cy='38' r='5' fill='#0a4a2a'/>
    <circle cx='54' cy='38' r='3.5' fill='#2ECC71'/>
    <circle cx='54' cy='38' r='1.5' fill='#F1C40F'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='14' ry='16' fill='#1B4F8A'/>

  <!-- Neck -->
  <rect x='45' y='50' width='10' height='15' rx='5' fill='#1B4F8A'/>

  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='46' r='9' fill='#1B4F8A'/>

  <!-- Crest feathers -->
  <line x1='46' y1='38' x2='43' y2='30' stroke='#2ECC71' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='29' r='2' fill='#F1C40F'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='37' x2='50' y2='28' stroke='#2ECC71' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='27' r='2' fill='#F1C40F'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='38' x2='57' y2='30' stroke='#2ECC71' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='29' r='2' fill='#F1C40F'/>

  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx='53' cy='44' r='2.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='53.5' cy='44' r='1.5' fill='#1B4F8A'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='43.5' r='0.7' fill='#FFFFFF'/>

  <!-- Beak -->
  <polygon points='58,46 63,47 58,49' fill='#F39C12'/>

  <!-- Waving wing/arm hello -->
  <g>
    <path d='M36,62 Q20,48 18,36' stroke='#1B4F8A' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- Open feather-hand -->
    <path d='M18,36 Q14,28 12,24' stroke='#2ECC71' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M18,36 Q16,26 16,22' stroke='#2ECC71' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M18,36 Q20,26 22,22' stroke='#2ECC71' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <circle cx='12' cy='23' r='2' fill='#F1C40F'/>
    <circle cx='16' cy='21' r='2' fill='#F1C40F'/>
    <circle cx='22' cy='21' r='2' fill='#F1C40F'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Other wing resting -->
  <path d='M64,62 Q72,68 74,76' stroke='#1B4F8A' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Legs -->
  <line x1='45' y1='83' x2='43' y2='93' stroke='#E67E22' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='43' y1='93' x2='38' y2='95' stroke='#E67E22' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='43' y1='93' x2='43' y2='96' stroke='#E67E22' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='43' y1='93' x2='48' y2='95' stroke='#E67E22' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <line x1='55' y1='83' x2='57' y2='93' stroke='#E67E22' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='57' y1='93' x2='52' y2='95' stroke='#E67E22' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='57' y1='93' x2='57' y2='96' stroke='#E67E22' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='57' y1='93' x2='62' y2='95' stroke='#E67E22' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Cheek blush -->
  <circle cx='57' cy='47' r='2' fill='#2ECC71' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
